description: Shift totals, weekly hours and overtime from clock times.

faqs.a: As an overnight shift — the clock-out is assumed to be the next day. So 22:00 to 06:00 counts as 8 hours.
Anything over 40 hours in the week counts as overtime. This is the common US-style threshold, not a legal ruling for your country.
Only if you enter an hourly rate. Leave the rate blank and you get hours without the pay estimate.
faqs.q: Is the pay estimate shown without a rate?

howto: Enter clock-in, clock-out and unpaid break minutes for each day you worked.
Leave days you did not work blank.
Optionally enter your hourly rate for a pay estimate.
Press Calculate for per-day hours, the week total and overtime.
title: Work Hours Calculator
